veredicto.limpia_sin_datos: No objections in what was checked; checks without data: {sin_datos}

Q1.significa: The document is missing something an invoice must have, such as the number, the other party, the date, the period, the amounts or the VAT.
Q1.que_hacer: Check the original and fill in the missing details.

fallo.texto: Missing on the document: {faltan|codigo}.
Required details are missing on the document.

sin_datos.texto: This was not asked for when the document was read: {no_solicitado|codigo}. It cannot be checked.
Not all required details were asked for when the document was read.

Q2.significa: An important field was read with doubt and nobody has checked it yet.
Q2.que_hacer: Compare the field with the original, then verify or correct it.

fallo.texto: Read with doubt and not yet verified: {campos|codigo}.
A field was read with doubt and is not yet verified.

Q3.significa: The notes on the document contain text aimed at whoever processes it, such as a new IBAN or a request to change details. This can be an attempt at fraud.
Q3.que_hacer: Do not act on the text. Read the original and raise it if something is wrong; bank details always come from the master data.

fallo.texto: The notes contain: {marcas|codigo}. This is not acted on, only reviewed.
The notes contain text aimed at whoever processes the document.

Q4.significa: The original document is not in the archive; only the data read from it is there.
Q4.que_hacer: Ask for the original again and import it.

fallo.texto: The original document was not stored: only what was read from it is left.

X1.significa: The invoice, bank transaction or import row is not in euros. It is left out of all totals.
X1.que_hacer: Check the currency and get a version in euros, or handle it outside the system.

fallo.texto: Import rows with amounts not in euros: {filas|cuenta}. They were not imported.
Amounts in {moneda}: not in euros, so left out of all totals.
Not in euros, so left out of all totals.

sin_datos.texto: No amount can be read, so the currency is unknown.

M2.significa: An invoice line that a person had changed or excluded is not in the new reading of the document. The line is kept as it was.
M2.que_hacer: Decide whether the line stays: exclude it if it no longer exists, or accept the finding with a reason.

fallo.texto: Invoice line {orden} had been excluded and the new reading no longer contains it.
Invoice line {orden} was changed by a person and the new reading no longer contains it. It is kept as it was.
A changed invoice line is not in the new reading.

M3.significa: A sales invoice from Exact (or TRNSPRNT) and its PDF do not say the same, or they share a number and could not be joined. The booked invoice is the one that counts.
M3.que_hacer: Look at the difference and correct the invoice in Exact, or join the PDF to the right invoice.

fallo.texto: The PDF has the number of a booked invoice, but the client is different or unknown, so they were not joined. Until then the sale counts twice.
The PDF has the number of a booked invoice and was not joined to it ({distintos.union|codigo}). Until then the sale counts twice.
The PDF and the booked invoice are not joined or do not say the same. Until this is sorted out, the sale may count twice.

Z1.significa: The latest data from a source (bank, Exact or TRNSPRNT) is older than allowed. Checks that depend on it cannot run.
Z1.que_hacer: Import a new export or bank statement.

fallo.texto: The latest data from the bank is from {exportado|fecha}: {edad} working days old, the limit is {limite}.
The latest data from Exact is from {exportado|fecha}: {edad} days old, the limit is {limite}.
The latest data from TRNSPRNT is from {exportado|fecha}: {edad} days old, the limit is {limite}.
The latest data from a source is too old.

Z2.significa: The latest import from a source rejected rows (or was rejected completely), or names a party, Object or person that is not in the master data. Nothing is created automatically.
Z2.que_hacer: Fix the file or the master data and import it again.

fallo.texto: The latest import was rejected completely: nothing was imported.
Rejected rows: {rechazadas}. References not in the master data: {sin_resolver|cuenta}.
Rejected rows in the latest import: {rechazadas}.
The latest import rejected rows.

A0.significa: No provider or client in the master data matches this invoice exactly (VAT ID, KvK number or confirmed alias), or more than one does.
A0.que_hacer: Choose the right provider or client, or add it to the master data first.

fallo.texto: Several parties in the master data ({candidatos}) share this VAT ID or KvK number; it is not clear which one it is.
Nobody in the master data matches exactly. On the invoice: {nombre}, VAT ID {btw}, KvK number {kvk}.
Nobody in the master data matches this invoice exactly.

sin_datos.texto: The master data has not been imported yet, so it is unknown whether this party is known.

A2.significa: The name, KvK number or VAT ID on the invoice differs from the master data of this party.
A2.que_hacer: Check that it really is the same party. If it is another trading name, confirm it as an alias.

partes.texto: VAT ID on the invoice: {btw.0}; in the master data: {btw.1}.
KvK number on the invoice: {kvk.0}; in the master data: {kvk.1}.
Name on the invoice: {nombre.0}; known names: {nombre.1}.

fallo.texto: What is printed on the invoice does not match the master data.

sin_datos.texto: The master data from Exact is out of date, so it was not compared.

A5.significa: A purchase invoice without the provider's VAT ID that does not mention the KOR is blocked. A Dutch VAT ID with the wrong format is held.
A5.que_hacer: Ask the provider for an invoice with a valid VAT ID, or record that the KOR applies.

fallo.texto: The VAT ID {btw} does not have the Dutch format (NL, nine digits, B, two digits).
The invoice has no VAT ID of the provider and does not mention the KOR.

A7.significa: What a provider prints differs from their previous invoice. A different VAT ID or KvK number holds the invoice; a different name or address is a warning.
A7.que_hacer: Check with the provider (using the contact details on file) that the change is genuine.

fallo.texto: The details differ from the previous invoice.

A8.significa: The invoice is not addressed to BM Support BV, or an invoice that came in as a sale was not issued by BM Support BV.
A8.que_hacer: Check that the invoice is for BM Support BV and in the right folder.

fallo.texto: Came in as a sales invoice, without an issuer and addressed to BM Support BV: probably a purchase invoice in the wrong folder.
Came in as a sales invoice but issued by {emisor}, not by BM Support BV: it is in the wrong folder.

partes.texto: Addressed to {nombre}, not to BM Support BV.
Recipient VAT ID: {btw}, not that of BM Support BV.

fallo.texto: The invoice is not addressed to BM Support BV.

sin_datos.texto: The document does not say who issued it or who it is addressed to (or this was not asked for when it was read).

B2.significa: The same party has more than one invoice with the same number, and they have not been merged or linked.
B2.que_hacer: Compare the invoices. If it is a repeated sending, merge them; if it is a credit note or correction, link them.

fallo.texto: The same number ({numero_norm}) is on {facturas|cuenta} invoices from the same party.
This number appears more than once for the same party.

sin_datos.texto: The document does not say who it is from, so duplicates cannot be checked.

B3.significa: Same party, same total, at most 14 days apart, compatible periods and a different number.
B3.que_hacer: Compare both invoices. If they are the same invoice, merge them; if both are genuine, accept the finding with a reason.

fallo.texto: Same total ({totales_cent.1|dinero}) as another invoice from the same party; days apart: {dias}.
Same total as another invoice from the same party.

sin_datos.texto: Party, total or date is missing, so duplicates by amount cannot be checked.

B4.significa: The invoice periods of the same party overlap (per Object when the lines name one), without a confirmed link or credit note.
B4.que_hacer: Check whether the same period was invoiced twice, and link or credit if needed.

fallo.texto: The period {periodos.1.0|fecha} – {periodos.1.1|fecha} overlaps {periodos.0.0|fecha} – {periodos.0.1|fecha} of another invoice; days of overlap: {dias}.
The period overlaps another invoice from the same party.

sin_datos.texto: Party or full period is missing, so overlap cannot be checked.

B5.significa: A shift in the planning is matched with more purchase hours than it has, from two or more invoices that do not explain each other.
B5.que_hacer: Compare the invoices and ask the provider for a credit note for the double hours.

fallo.texto: Shift {turno} has {horas_mil|horas} h, but {facturas|cuenta} invoices together charge {conciliadas_mil|horas} h for it.
The same hours from the planning are invoiced twice.

sin_datos.texto: Could not be compared with the planning: no planning has been imported yet, the planning does not cover these days, or the invoice line does not say which days or which person or Object it is for.

V7.significa: A client was billed twice: the same number, the same amount shortly after each other, or the same hours of a shift on two invoices.
V7.que_hacer: Compare the sales invoices and send a credit note if needed.

fallo.texto: Invoice number {numero_norm} was sent to this client {facturas|cuenta} times.
Same total ({totales_cent.1|dinero}) as another sales invoice to this client; days apart: {dias}.
Shift {turno} has {horas_mil|horas} h, but {facturas|cuenta} sales invoices together charge {conciliadas_mil|horas} h for it.
This client may have been billed twice.

sin_datos.texto: The document does not say who was billed, so double billing cannot be checked.

C4.significa: The invoice falls in a VAT quarter that was already filed and is not what was declared for it: it arrived later, changed afterwards or no longer counts there.
C4.que_hacer: Put the invoice on the list for the accountant; the correction goes into a later return.

fallo.texto: Arrived after the VAT return for {trimestre|trimestre} was filed: its VAT is not in that return.
Changed after the VAT return for {trimestre|trimestre} was filed: it no longer matches what was declared.
Declared in {trimestre|trimestre}, but no longer counts there (cancelled, replaced, another currency or a date in another quarter).
Does not match the VAT return that was already filed.

D1.significa: The breakdown is not complete: lines with quantity, rate and amount, the amount excl. VAT, the total and, when VAT is charged, the VAT rate and VAT amount.
D1.que_hacer: Fill in the missing parts from the original, or ask the provider for a complete invoice.

fallo.texto: Parts of the breakdown are missing; count: {faltan|cuenta}.
The breakdown is not complete.

D2.significa: The lines together must give the amount excl. VAT (1 cent per line plus 2 cents margin).
D2.que_hacer: Compare the lines with the original and correct the amount that was read wrongly.

fallo.texto: The lines add up to {lineas_cent|suma|dinero}; the amount excl. VAT is {base_cent|dinero}.
The lines do not add up to the amount excl. VAT.

sin_datos.texto: There is no readable amount excl. VAT.
There are no lines, or a line has no readable amount.

D2b.significa: Quantity times rate must give the amount of each line (1 cent margin).
D2b.que_hacer: Check quantity, rate and amount of the marked lines against the original.

fallo.texto: On at least one line, quantity times rate does not give the line amount.

sin_datos.texto: No line has quantity, rate and amount together.

D3.significa: The amount excl. VAT times the VAT rate must give the VAT amount, per rate (2 cents margin).
D3.que_hacer: Check the VAT rate and VAT amount against the original.

fallo.texto: In the VAT breakdown, the VAT amount of a rate does not match its amount excl. VAT.
{tipo_iva_pb|pct} VAT on {base_cent|dinero} does not give the {iva_cent|dinero} on the invoice.
The VAT amount does not match the rate.

sin_datos.texto: Amount excl. VAT, VAT rate or VAT amount is missing.

D4.significa: The amount excl. VAT plus the VAT must give the total (2 cents margin).
D4.que_hacer: Check the three amounts against the original and correct what was read wrongly.

fallo.texto: {base_cent|dinero} excl. VAT plus {iva_cent|dinero} VAT is not the total of {total_cent|dinero}.
Amount excl. VAT plus VAT is not the total.

sin_datos.texto: Amount excl. VAT, VAT or total is missing.

D6.significa: The rows of the VAT breakdown must add up to the amount excl. VAT and the VAT in the header. The VAT return uses the breakdown.
D6.que_hacer: Compare the VAT breakdown with the original and correct the row or the header.

fallo.texto: The VAT breakdown does not add up to the header ({base_cent|dinero} excl. VAT, {iva_cent|dinero} VAT).
The VAT breakdown does not add up to the header.

sin_datos.texto: Amount excl. VAT or VAT is missing in the header or in a breakdown row.

I1.significa: When an invoice line is split over several Objects, the parts must add up to the line amount. Otherwise the costs per Object count a different line.
I1.que_hacer: Split the line again so the parts add up to the line amount.

fallo.texto: The split of a line over Objects does not add up to the line amount.

sin_datos.texto: The split lines have no amount.

E0.significa: It is unknown how the invoice treats VAT, or with standard VAT the rate or VAT amount is missing.
E0.que_hacer: Read the VAT treatment and amounts on the original and fill them in.

fallo.texto: Standard VAT, but this is missing: {faltan|codigo}.
Standard VAT, but a VAT breakdown row lacks rate, amount or VAT.
It is unknown how this invoice treats VAT.

E1.titulo: VAT treatment differs from master data
E1.significa: The VAT treatment on the invoice is not the one recorded for the provider in the master data.
E1.que_hacer: Check which treatment is right and correct the invoice or the master data.

fallo.texto: On the invoice: {factura|codigo}; in the master data: {maestro|codigo}.
The VAT treatment differs from the master data.

sin_datos.texto: The master data from Exact is out of date, so it was not compared.

E2.significa: The VAT treatment differs from the provider's previous invoice, or it has a VAT rate that none of their earlier invoices had.
E2.que_hacer: Check with the provider that the change is correct.

fallo.texto: VAT treatment changed from {antes|codigo} to {ahora|codigo} compared with the previous invoice.
New VAT rate {tipos_nuevos|pct}; earlier invoices had {tipos_antes|pct}.
The VAT treatment or rate has changed.

E3.significa: Under the KOR (small business scheme) the provider does not charge VAT.
E3.que_hacer: Ask the provider for a corrected invoice without VAT.

fallo.texto: With the KOR there should be no VAT, but the invoice charges {iva_cent|dinero}.
With the KOR there should be no VAT, but the total ({total_cent|dinero}) is higher than the amount excl. VAT ({base_cent|dinero}).
With the KOR there should be no VAT.

sin_datos.texto: The VAT amount is not visible and cannot be derived from the total.

E4.significa: With reverse-charged VAT the invoice charges no VAT and shows the recipient's VAT ID.
E4.que_hacer: Ask the provider for a corrected invoice.

fallo.texto: With reverse-charged VAT there should be no VAT, but the invoice charges {iva_cent|dinero}.
With reverse-charged VAT there should be no VAT, but the total ({total_cent|dinero}) is higher than the amount excl. VAT ({base_cent|dinero}).
With reverse-charged VAT the recipient's VAT ID must be on the invoice, and it is missing.

sin_datos.texto: The VAT amount is not visible and cannot be derived from the total.
The recipient's VAT ID was not asked for when the document was read.

E5.significa: What a KOR provider has invoiced to BM Support BV this year is close to the KOR threshold. It is a hint: the threshold covers everything they invoice.
E5.que_hacer: Ask the provider whether the KOR still applies to them.

fallo.texto: In {ano} this KOR provider has invoiced more to BM Support BV than the KOR threshold of {umbral_cent|dinero}. They probably have to start charging VAT.
In {ano} this KOR provider has already invoiced {aviso_pct}% or more of the KOR threshold ({umbral_cent|dinero}) to BM Support BV.
This KOR provider is close to the KOR threshold.

E7.significa: A VAT rate that is not on the list (0, 9 and 21%), or a sale with reverse-charged or 0% VAT to a client not marked for that in the master data.
E7.que_hacer: Check the rate or treatment, and the client's setting in the master data.

fallo.texto: Unusual VAT rate: {tipos|pct}.
Sale with {tratamiento_iva|codigo} to a client not marked for that in the master data.
Unusual VAT rate or treatment.

sin_datos.texto: Sale with {tratamiento_iva|codigo} to an unknown client: it is unknown whether that is allowed.
The client is unknown, so the VAT treatment cannot be checked.

F0.significa: The bank accounts from the first master data are the starting point, but nobody has confirmed them.
F0.que_hacer: Have someone with the right permission confirm the accounts.

fallo.texto: Inherited accounts not yet confirmed: {cuentas|cuenta}.
There are inherited accounts that are not yet confirmed.

F1.significa: The IBAN on the invoice must pass the check-digit test (modulo 97).
F1.que_hacer: Check the IBAN on the original. Payments never go to the IBAN on an invoice.

fallo.texto: {iban|iban} fails the check: it is not a valid IBAN.
The IBAN on the invoice is not valid.

sin_datos.texto: The invoice shows no IBAN.

F2.significa: The IBAN on the invoice is not a payable account of this provider. A payable account is verified, confirmed or inherited, is in the latest Exact master data and has no open change.
F2.que_hacer: Payments only go to an account from the master data. If the IBAN is new, have it verified by phone first.

fallo.texto: Without a known provider no account is payable; {iban|iban} cannot be checked.
{iban|iban} is not in this provider's account register.
{iban|iban} was rejected by a person.
{iban|iban} is inherited but not yet confirmed or verified.
{iban|iban} is registered but not yet verified.
{iban|iban} has an open change in the master data or is not in the latest Exact master data.
The IBAN on the invoice is not payable.

sin_datos.texto: There are no accounts from Exact yet, or the Exact master data is out of date: it is unknown which account is payable.

F3.significa: The IBAN on the invoice is new for this provider, or was rejected. A phone check is needed.
F3.que_hacer: Call the provider on the phone number that was in the master data before this invoice, never a number from the invoice, and record the call.

fallo.texto: {iban|iban} is on file but was rejected or never accepted by a phone check.
{iban|iban} is new for this provider.
The IBAN on the invoice is new for this provider.

sin_datos.texto: The master data from Exact is out of date, so it was not compared.

F4.significa: The IBAN is registered to someone else, or the invoice mentions factoring, assignment or a G-account. The invoice is blocked and escalated.
F4.que_hacer: Escalate this to the person responsible; do not pay until it is sorted out.

partes.texto: The invoice mentions factoring, assignment or a G-account: the payment would go to a third party.

fallo.texto: The payment would go to a third party.

F5.significa: An account was added, changed or removed in later master data and has not been verified by phone.
F5.que_hacer: Call the provider on the number from before the change and record the check.

fallo.texto: Account {iban|iban} changed in the master data ({cambios.0.0|codigo}) and has not been verified by phone.
This provider has an unverified account change: {cuentas|iban}.
There is an unverified account change in the master data.

F6.significa: Exact and TRNSPRNT list different accounts for the same provider.
F6.que_hacer: Find out which account is right and correct the system that is wrong.

fallo.texto: Exact: {exact|iban}. TRNSPRNT: {trnsprnt|iban}.
Exact and TRNSPRNT list different accounts.

F7.significa: A bank payment to a provider went to an account that is not payable for them, and that is not a known payee or one of the company's own accounts.
F7.que_hacer: Find out at once where the money went and escalate it to the person responsible.

fallo.texto: A payment to {iban|iban} is a payment to this provider, but that account is not payable for them.
A payment went to a non-payable account.

sin_datos.texto: Without up-to-date master data from Exact it is unknown which accounts are payable.

F8.significa: The phone check does not count: the call was not made to the master-data number from before the document, the number changed during the waiting period, or the person who verified lacked the permission.
F8.que_hacer: Have the account verified again by someone with the permission, using the right number.

fallo.texto: The phone check of {iban|iban} does not count.
A phone check does not count.

F9.significa: The verification phone number of a provider has just changed: a waiting period applies.
F9.que_hacer: Check that the change of number is genuine; only verify after the waiting period.

fallo.texto: The verification number changed on {dia|fecha}: until {hasta|fecha} no phone check of this provider counts.
The verification number has just changed.

F10.titulo: Foreign IBAN on a sales invoice
F10.significa: A sales invoice shows an IBAN that is not a BM Support BV account: the client would pay into another account.
F10.que_hacer: Correct the invoice before the client pays.

fallo.texto: The sales invoice shows {iban|iban}, not a BM Support BV account.
The sales invoice shows someone else's IBAN.

sin_datos.texto: The company's own accounts are not set up yet, so it is unknown whether this IBAN belongs to BM Support BV.

K1.significa: Not paid after the due date: a purchase invoice from the next day, a sales invoice after the days in the policy.
K1.que_hacer: Make sure the purchase invoice gets paid or find out why not; for a sales invoice, chase the client for payment.

fallo.texto: Overdue since {vencimiento|fecha}; still open: {pendiente_cent|dinero}.
Not paid after the due date.

sin_datos.texto: Overdue, but no up-to-date bank statement or Exact export covers the period since the due date: it is unknown whether it was paid.

K2.significa: What is confirmed as paid does not bring the balance to zero: a part payment or an overpayment.
K2.que_hacer: Find the rest of the payment, or ask for the overpayment back.

fallo.texto: Total {total_cent|dinero}, paid {pagado_cent|dinero} ({fuente|codigo}), credited {acreditado_cent|dinero}, still open {pendiente_cent|dinero}.
Total {total_cent|dinero}, paid {pagado_cent|dinero} ({fuente|codigo}), still open {pendiente_cent|dinero}.
The amount paid does not bring the balance to zero.

sin_datos.texto: There are payments, but no total in euros to compare them with.

K3.titulo: Marked paid by hand, not seen at bank
K3.significa: Marked as paid by hand, and after the days in the policy no bank statement shows the payment.
K3.que_hacer: Check that the payment was really made, and withdraw the mark otherwise.

fallo.texto: Marked as paid by hand on {fecha_pago|fecha}, but the bank does not show that payment.
Marked as paid by hand, but the bank does not show that payment.

sin_datos.texto: Marked as paid by hand, but no up-to-date bank statement covers the days after the payment.

K4.significa: Two payments to the same account, for the same amount and with the same reference within a few days, or an invoice overpaid with two payments.
K4.que_hacer: Ask the recipient to refund the double payment.

fallo.texto: {movimientos|cuenta} payments of {importe_cent|abs|dinero} to {ibans|iban} with reference {referencia}, shortly after each other: possibly paid twice.
Paid twice: the payments together are {pagado_cent|dinero} for a total of {total_cent|dinero}.
It may have been paid twice.

K5.significa: It was paid on a day when the invoice had a blocking finding that was still open.
K5.que_hacer: Find out why it was paid anyway and whether the money has to come back.

fallo.texto: Paid on {fecha_pago|fecha} while the invoice was blocked.
Paid while the invoice was blocked.

K6.significa: A statement's opening balance is not the previous closing balance, or a number is missing. What was paid since then does not count yet.

fallo.texto: The statements of account {cuenta|iban} do not connect: a statement or a balance is missing.
Paid with transactions from statements after a break: the payment does not count yet.
The bank statements do not connect.

K7.significa: A bank transaction is still not matched with any invoice after the days in the policy.
K7.que_hacer: Match the transaction with the right invoice, or record what it is.

fallo.texto: Transaction of {importe_cent|dinero} on {fecha|fecha}; not matched: {sin_casar_cent|dinero}.
A bank transaction is not matched with any invoice.

K8.significa: The bank and Exact show different amounts paid for the same invoice.
K8.que_hacer: Find out which is right and correct the entry in Exact.

fallo.texto: The bank shows {banco_cent|dinero} paid, Exact {exact_cent|dinero}.
The bank and Exact show different amounts paid.

K9.titulo: Payments on an invoice that does not count
K9.significa: A cancelled or merged invoice has confirmed payments: that money counts in no total until someone says where it belongs.
K9.que_hacer: Withdraw the payment and record it on the invoice it pays, or bring the invoice back.

fallo.texto: This invoice no longer counts, but has {pagado_cent|dinero} in confirmed payments ({fuente|codigo}).
This invoice no longer counts, but has confirmed payments.

G1.significa: A purchase invoice without any shift of the provider or their people in the invoiced period.
G1.que_hacer: Ask where the work was done and check the planning. Accepting needs a second signature.

fallo.texto: No planning has been imported. The planning is required, so this purchase cannot pass without it.
The planning is out of date. The planning is required, so this purchase cannot pass without a current one.
The planning does not cover {desde|fecha} – {hasta|fecha}. The planning is required, so this purchase cannot pass without it.
No shift of the provider or their people in the planning from {desde|fecha} to {hasta|fecha}.
No shift of the provider in the planning in the invoiced period.

sin_datos.texto: Could not be compared with the planning: no planning has been imported yet, the planning does not cover these days, or the invoice line does not say which days or which person or Object it is for.

G2.significa: The invoiced hours against the validated hours in the planning, compared as finely as possible (person and day, Object and day, week or period), with a quarter of an hour margin per day.
G2.que_hacer: Compare the hours with the planning and ask the provider for a correction if needed.

fallo.texto: Invoiced {facturadas_mil|horas} h ({nivel|codigo}, {desde|fecha} – {hasta|fecha}); the planning has at most {tope_mil|horas} h, with shifts not yet validated: {sin_validar}.

Invoiced {facturadas_mil|horas} h, validated in the planning {validadas_mil|horas} h ({nivel|codigo}, {desde|fecha} – {hasta|fecha}). Difference {diferencia_mil|horas} h, more than the margin of {tolerancia_mil|horas} h.
The invoiced hours differ from the validated hours in the planning.

sin_datos.texto: Could not be compared with the planning: no planning has been imported yet, the planning does not cover these days, or the invoice line does not say which days or which person or Object it is for.

G3.significa: The rate of a purchase line against the agreed rate, or otherwise the shift rate in the planning or earlier rates for the same work. Above it holds; far above it blocks.
G3.que_hacer: Compare the rate with the agreement and ask the provider for a credit note if needed.

fallo.texto: Line rate {tarifa_e4|tarifa}; agreed ({nivel|codigo}): {pactada_e4|tarifa}. Difference on this line: {valor_cent|dinero}.

iva.significa: VAT amounts, rates or treatments that are wrong or missing.

lecturas_dudosas.significa: Fields read with doubt and not yet verified.

otros.significa: Everything that does not fit one of the other groups.

extraccion.significa: Read automatically from the PDF; not yet confirmed by a person.

importacion.significa: From an export of Exact, TRNSPRNT or the bank.

maestro.significa: From the provider's or client's master data.

manual_entrada.significa: A person filled in a missing value.

manual_correccion.significa: A person changed the value, with a reason.

calculado.significa: Derived from other data, for example the due date from the invoice date and the payment term.

faltante.significa: The field is required and has no value.

dudoso.significa: Read with doubt and not yet verified.

discrepancia.significa: Does not match another source, such as the master data or the planning.

anomalia.significa: Differs from what is usual or from earlier invoices.

verificado.significa: A person has checked the value.

normal.significa: Nothing urgent; handle in the usual order.

atencion.significa: Something needs a look, but it is not in a hurry yet.

urgente.significa: Look at it today: a deadline is close or money is at stake.

bloqueada.significa: There is an objection that must be solved first; the reason is shown.

retencion.significa: The invoice waits until someone has looked at this.

aviso.significa: A warning; the invoice still goes on.

anadir_nota.descripcion: Add an internal note to an invoice or exception.

cambiar_po.descripcion: Say whether a reference on the invoice is a PO number (or something else).

anadir_referencia.descripcion: Add a reference (PO, order, project, client's) that was not read.

cerrar_po.confirmar: The status of this PO will be changed. Continue?

objetos_po.descripcion: Add Objects to or remove them from a PO.

corregir_po.descripcion: Correct the issue date, start date or document of a PO.

imputar_po.descripcion: Charge an invoice line to a PO (or remove the PO).
imputar_po.confirmar: This line will count in the use of this PO from now on. Continue?

excluir_linea.descripcion: Exclude an invoice line; it is kept, not deleted.

anadir_linea.descripcion: Add a line that is on the paper but was not read.

dividir_linea.descripcion: Split a line over several Objects; the parts add up to the line amount.

corregir_maestro.confirmar: The master data will be changed. Continue?

deshacer_fusion.confirmar: This invoice will count on its own again. Continue?

rechazar_relacion.descripcion: Reject a suggested link; it will not be suggested again.
rechazar_relacion.confirmar: This link will be rejected. Continue?

retirar_relacion.confirmar: This link will no longer change balances or VAT. Continue?

devolver_factura.descripcion: Return an invoice with a note saying why.

crear_excepcion.descripcion: Open an exception on an invoice by hand.

rechazar_iban.descripcion: Reject a provider's account and say what happens to the invoice.
rechazar_iban.confirmar: This account will be rejected for this provider. Continue?

atestar_iban.descripcion: Confirm an account from the first master data (or all that are still open).

retirar_beneficiario.descripcion: Withdraw a known payee (kept, not deleted).

retirar_pago.descripcion: Withdraw a suggested, linked or manual payment that is wrong (it is kept).
retirar_pago.confirmar: This payment will no longer count in the balance. Continue?

ver_facturas.descripcion: View everything: invoices, parties, POs, VAT and cash flow.

editar_extraccion.descripcion: Correct values read from a document.

anular_aviso.descripcion: Accept findings with a reason, and give a second signature.

revisar_factura.descripcion: Mark invoices as reviewed or return them.

gestionar_btw.descripcion: Prepare quarters and record a filed return. The system files nothing itself.

importar_datos.descripcion: Import exports from Exact, TRNSPRNT and the bank.
